# Repository git hooks

Project-tracked hooks. Activate them once per clone with:

```sh
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
```

## `commit-msg`

Rejects commit messages that credit AI tools — `Co-authored-by:` trailers
naming Copilot / Claude / GPT / Codex / Gemini / Cursor / Anthropic, plus
"generated by", "with help from", and the 🤖 marker. Project policy is
that AI assistance is not credited in git history.

Bypass for genuine human contributors who happen to share one of these
names:

```sh
git commit --no-verify ...
```
